name: Carbacid Investments

rows.label: Total liabilities
rows.source: Carbacid Investments plc audited group results for the year ended 31 July 2025, summarised consolidated statement of financial position, printed in KSh thousand (NSE filing, audited by RSM Eastern Africa LLP, unqualified opinion). Printed: non-current assets 4,799,480 (2025) and 4,456,841 (2024); current assets 1,868,205 and 1,821,482; current liabilities 634,502 and 670,741; non-current liabilities 891,589 (borrowings 500,554 plus deferred income taxes 391,035) and 1,035,654 (borrowings 655,496 plus deferred income taxes 380,158); total equity 5,141,594 and 4,571,928. The filing ties exactly: non-current plus current assets equals total assets 6,667,685 (2024: 6,278,323); current plus non-current liabilities equals total liabilities 1,526,091 (2024: 1,706,395); assets less liabilities equals total equity in both years. FY2024 agreed to the stored totals to the shilling, so the FY2025 stored total assets and total liabilities, which sat 12,003 thousand higher on a vendor aggregation, are aligned to the audited figures.
